[EN] Would You Like to See the Wine List?
[ES] ¿Te gustaría ver la carta de vinos?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I want to treat them to a feast.
[ES] Quiero invitarles a un banquete.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We should always be grateful for what we have.
[ES] Siempre debemos estar agradecidos por lo que tenemos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "My pleasure!"
[ES] ¡El placer es mío!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet Halwyn, who is scouting the northeast Deathfrost Plains.
[ES] Reúnete con Halwyn, quien está explorando el noreste de Deathfrost Plains.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "What's in here?"
[ES] ¿Qué hay aquí?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the wine barrel near the wrecked ship in the Deathfrost Plains.
[ES] Encuentra el barril de vino cerca del barco naufragado en Deathfrost Plains.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Officers' Rations
[ES] Raciones de Oficiales
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect bottles of wine from the drowned gula officers.
[ES] Recolecta botellas de vino de los oficiales gula ahogados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the wine to Halwyn on the Deathfrost Plains.
[ES] Llévale el vino a Halwyn en Deathfrost Plains.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll enjoy this."
[ES] Disfrutaré esto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
